title: feat(runtime): package jobs honour the host's per-kernel scheduledWorkPolicy
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUJTu64tU69Q3BhNU1nAuhF)_

Fixes #31382

Clause-②: yes — an optional `scheduledWorkPolicy` member on `AppPlugin` / `AppArtifactJobSchedulingOptions` (both exported from runtime's `.` entry, measured: `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` exports `AppPlugin` and the type `AppArtifactJobSchedulingOptions`) and two names newly exported by `@objectstack/types` (`ScheduledWorkPolicySource`, `readScheduledWorkPolicy`) widen published surfaces; nothing narrows
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`AppPlugin` 和包 job 排程器 `scheduleAppArtifactJobs` 现在接受宿主按内核给的 `scheduledWorkPolicy`(值或解析函数),和引擎、两个时间触发器用的是同一个类型。策略关掉时,这个内核不排程包里的 `jobs`,之前排过的取消,日志写宿主自己的原因。
- 为什么改:宿主(云端托管运行时)按内核关掉定时工作后,`schedule` 流程不武装,但同一个包的 `jobs` 还在跑。云端实测 Free 环境 2.5 秒写了 5 行(cloud#3733 等这个缝)。
- 风险与回滚:不传策略时逐字节照旧,只读部署开关 `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED`(新增 CONTROL 钉住)。`ScheduledWorkPolicySource` / `readScheduledWorkPolicy` 从 `@objectstack/trigger-schedule` 挪到 `@objectstack/types`,trigger-schedule 原名再导出,导入方不用改。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts` 的 `scheduleAppArtifactJobs` 开关段(`hostPolicy` 一读两用);`packages/types/src/env.ts` 新增的两个名字;`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` 构造参数。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/app-plugin.scheduled-work-policy.test.ts`,预期 9 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `AppArtifactJobSchedulingOptions` gains an optional `scheduledWorkPolicy?: ScheduledWorkPolicySource` (a `ScheduledWorkPolicy` value or a resolver). When it is present, `scheduleAppArtifactJobs` reads it **once** per call and uses that one reading in place of both zero-argument reads: `enabled` for the gate (instead of `resolveScheduledWorkEnabled()`), and `requiresActingOrganization` / `runOwnership` for the per-job organization rule (instead of `resolveScheduledWorkPolicy()`).
- Off: nothing is scheduled, `withheld: 'scheduled-work-disabled'`, the app's previously scheduled jobs are cancelled through `retireAppJobs` as today, and the one `info` line carries `scheduledWorkDisabledReason(policy)`, so a host's `hostDisabledReason` (#21110) is printed instead of the deployment sentence.
- A host resolver that throws fails closed, like the deployment posture read: nothing scheduled, prior jobs cancelled, `withheld: 'scheduled-work-policy-unreadable'`, one `error` line.
- `AppPlugin`'s third constructor argument gains the same optional `scheduledWorkPolicy` and hands it to the binder on `kernel:ready`.
- Absent policy: the code path is the old one, read for read (`resolveScheduledWorkEnabled()` before the job-service probe, `resolveScheduledWorkPolicy()` after it).
- One spelling of the source type: `@objectstack/runtime` does not depend on `@objectstack/trigger-schedule` (and should not), so `ScheduledWorkPolicySource` and `readScheduledWorkPolicy` move into `@objectstack/types` `env.ts` beside `ScheduledWorkPolicy`. `schedule-trigger.ts` imports them from there and re-exports both under the same names, so `@objectstack/trigger-schedule`'s entry still exports `ScheduledWorkPolicySource` and the triggers' behaviour is unchanged. The seat widened the claim's file face for this before any edit (claim 6718074628).
- Changeset `31382-package-jobs-host-scheduled-work-policy.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` patch, `@objectstack/types` patch, `@objectstack/trigger-schedule` patch (ruling A, #25105: a widening of TypeScript exports is not a metadata-protocol change).

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.scheduled-work-policy.test.ts` (9 cells), the deployment switch ON as the hosted runtime sets it:

- Two kernels in one process, each with the real `CronJobAdapter`: the `AppPlugin` handed `enabled: false` holds no job and never runs it; the sibling handed `enabled: true` holds the same job and runs it on trigger.
- A resolver policy is read at `kernel:ready`; a third kernel in the same process with no policy stays on the deployment switch.
- Cancel: a kernel rebuilt with an off policy on the same job service cancels the job the earlier boot scheduled.
- Host reason: one `info` line containing `hostDisabledReason`, and not naming `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED`.
- Binder: off ⇒ `withheld`, prior jobs in `cancelled`; an `isolated` policy (`requiresActingOrganization: true`) puts an org-less job in `missingOrganization` while the deployment posture is `single`; a throwing resolver ⇒ `scheduled-work-policy-unreadable`, prior job cancelled, one `error`.
- Absent policy (CONTROL): switch off ⇒ the `info` line is exactly `[Test] declarative jobs NOT scheduled — ` plus `SCHEDULED_WORK_DISABLED_REASON`; switch off but host hands `enabled: true` ⇒ scheduled.

The existing suites `app-plugin.jobs.test.ts`, `app-artifact-handlers.jobs.test.ts`, `app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts` (zero-argument path, deployment sentence, posture rules) are unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Red first and ablations</summary>

Red first on `77a675db` (`main`), the new file in place and no fix: `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed (9)`. The one green was the absent-policy deployment-sentence CONTROL. The two-kernels cell read `AssertionError: the off kernel holds no job: expected [ 'hourly_sweep' ] to deeply equal []`; the posture cell read `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'orgless_job' ]`.

Ablations via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix (`260d1c1d`); each printed `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0` and then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (f980f08feb00) and git diff HEAD is empty`:

1. Gate back to the deployment switch only (`if (!resolveScheduledWorkEnabled())`): `Tests 6 failed | 3 passed (9)` (two-kernels, resolver, cancel, host reason, binder off, throwing-resolver cells).
2. Reason back to the deployment constant: `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, the host-reason cell.
3. Posture half back to `resolveScheduledWorkPolicy()`: `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, the `requiresActingOrganization` cell.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, recorded: `AutomationEngineOptions.scheduledWorkPolicy` in `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` still spells the union inline (`ScheduledWorkPolicy | (() => ScheduledWorkPolicy)`) and keeps its own private `readScheduledWorkPolicy()`. It is structurally the same type, so a host passes one value to all three; pointing it at `@objectstack/types`' `ScheduledWorkPolicySource` is a follow-up for the seat.
- `@objectstack/trigger-schedule` keeps exporting `ScheduledWorkPolicySource` from its entry; `readScheduledWorkPolicy` was and stays off its entry (only `schedule-trigger.ts` re-exports it, for `time-relative-trigger.ts`).

## Verification

All local runs on head `85ab0691` (branch merged with `origin/main` at `00a88375`); the second commit only adds a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` to the new test, after which `check:test-source-alias`, the new suite and runtime `typecheck` were re-run green.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 69 derived families. `--ran` with exit codes recorded: `69 derived, 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: reads every package's `dist/`, and only the runtime / trigger-schedule closures were built here). CI builds the full tree and runs it.
- First pass reds, fixed and re-run green: `check:test-source-alias` (the new test reached `@objectstack/metadata` through `AppPlugin`'s dynamic import; fixed with the convention's module-top import), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3, shallow clone; `git fetch --depth=1` of the pinned fixture commit, then exit 0), `@objectstack/trigger-schedule` test/typecheck (its devDependency `@objectstack/service-automation` was not built; after building `@objectstack/trigger-schedule^...`, exit 0).
- Package suites: `@objectstack/runtime` test `Test Files 556 passed (556)`, `Tests 8966 passed | 19 skipped (8985)`; `@objectstack/types` test `Test Files 37 passed (37)`, `Tests 870 passed (870)`; `@objectstack/trigger-schedule` test and typecheck exit 0; runtime and types typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the five touched source files: exit 0.
- Full record: `pm-orders/server/31382-gates-ran.txt` (command :: exit code).
